report.title: Memo detail page not refresh after editing and saving the content
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Demo site (demo.usememos.com)

### Memos Version

v0.26.2

### Bug Description

On the memo details page, after editing and saving the content, the page still displays the old content before editing.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Copy memo link using "Copy Link" menu
2. Visit memo detail page with the link
3. Edit memo content
4. Click save button

### Expected Behavior

The memo detail page should show the new content after edit, but it shows the old content, you have to refresh browser to get latest content.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

preconditions: a memo exists that the signed-in user can edit

Change the memo content to 'edited content'
plan.expected: After saving, the memo detail page shows the new content 'edited content' and no longer shows 'original content', without a browser refresh
plan.reported_actual: After saving the edit on the memo detail page, the page still shows the old content until the browser is refreshed
missing: What exact memo content did the reporter use before and after editing?
Does the issue occur only when the detail page is reached via the copied link, or also by clicking the memo timestamp?
assumed: the memo content values 'original content' and 'edited content' are placeholders because the reporter gave none
assumed: the detail page is reached by clicking the memo's timestamp or navigating to the memo's own page, since the copied link cannot be read from the clipboard
assumed: the Edit option is in the memo's three-dot menu on the detail page
plan.summary: Memo detail page keeps showing old content after editing and saving until browser refresh

# Memo detail page not refresh after editing and saving the content

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:15320/.
Stay on localhost:15320 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Create a new memo with the text 'original content' and save it
2. Open the menu of the new memo and click 'Copy Link'
3. Open the memo's detail page (the page for that single memo, as the copied link would open)
4. Click the edit option for the memo in its menu
5. Change the memo content to 'edited content'
6. Click the Save button
The reporter says the correct behavior is that After saving, the memo detail page shows the new content 'edited content' and no longer shows 'original content', without a browser refresh. Verify that After saving, the memo detail page shows the new content 'edited content' and no longer shows 'original content', without a browser refresh.

verdict.headline: Copy Link says that the memo link was copied, but the clipboard is empty, so the memo detail page cannot be opened from the copied link.
verdict.root_cause: The Copy Link action did not put a usable memo link on the clipboard even though the app reported that it had succeeded.
verdict.suggested_fix: Investigate the Copy Link clipboard write and its permission/error handling. Only show the success message after a usable link has been written, and provide a clear failure message if copying is unavailable.

run.reason: Copy Link produced an empty clipboard and clicking the memo only focused its article, so its detail page cannot be opened as written.
